scientific.integrity: The source SVD alignment formula reduces the original-task derivatives to the principal square root of a two-task Gram matrix applied to the all-ones vector. The exact two-by-two square-root formula yields the stated sign inequalities.
limitations: The general non-conflict failure is prior-covered; only the full-rank phase diagram and symmetric identity are claimed.

title: Uniform Aligned-MTL has a sharp full-rank conflict window
